name: rodeo
description: Electron autoUpdater feed URL is plaintext http://bareback.s.yhat.com. Abandoned 2017. [Opus-verified: CONFIRMED-D]

later_review_audit.description: The Electron updater constructs a plaintext HTTP feed URL and hands it to Squirrel’s download/install flow. The retained source does not show an independent application signature policy in this path.
limitations: Source review is limited to the retained commit and does not establish released-artifact or current-upstream behavior.
